description:
Klee is a playable Pyro character in Genshin Impact .

The daughter of the intrepid and often quite destructive adventurer Alice , Klee takes after her mother in many ways, much to the dismay of the Knights of Favonius whom she has been entrusted to.
role_summary: Klee is a playable Pyro character in Genshin Impact .

talents.name: Kaboom!
talents.description: Normal Attack Throws things that go boom when they hit things! Performs up to 3 explosive attacks, dealing AoE Pyro DMG . Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and deals AoE Pyro DMG to opponents after a short casting time. Plunging Attack Gathering the power of Pyro, Klee plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Pyro DMG upon impact with the ground.

talents.name: Jumpy Dumpty
talents.description: Jumpy Dumpty is tons of boom-bang-fun! When thrown, Jumpy Dumpty bounces thrice, igniting and dealing AoE Pyro DMG with every bounce. On the third bounce, the bomb splits into many mines. The mines will explode upon contact with opponents, or after a short period of time, dealing AoE Pyro DMG . Starts with 2 charges .

talents.name: Sparks 'n' Splash
talents.description: Klee's Blazing Delight! For the duration of this ability, continuously summons Sparks 'n' Splash to attack nearby opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG .

talents.name: Pounding Surprise
talents.description: When Jumpy Dumpty and Normal Attacks deal DMG, Klee has a 50% chance to obtain an Explosive Spark. This Explosive Spark is consumed by the next Charged Attack, which costs no Stamina and deals 50% increased DMG.

talents.name: Sparkling Burst
talents.description: When Klee's Charged Attack results in a CRIT Hit, all party members gain 2 Elemental Energy .

talents.name: Sparkborne Magic
talents.description: After completing Witch's Homework : Of Leaves That Spark , Klee will become a Hexerei character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, which enhances Hexerei characters. Hexerei: Secret Rite When Klee deals DMG with Normal Attacks , Elemental Skills , or Elemental Bursts , she gains 1 Boom Badge, lasting 20s. Each type of attack can grant at most 1 Boom Badge this way, and each badge has its own independent timer. While Klee has 1/2/3 Boom Badges, her special Charged Attack Boom-Boom Strike deals 115%/130%/150% of its original DMG.

talents.name: All Of My Treasures!
talents.description: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Mondstadt on the mini-map .

c1.name: Chained Reactions
c1.effect: Description Hexerei Buff Gameplay Notes Advanced Properties Attacks and Skills have a certain chance to summon sparks that bombard opponents, dealing DMG equal to 120% of Sparks 'n' Splash 's DMG. Attacks and Skills have a certain chance to summon sparks that bombard opponents, dealing DMG equal to 120% of Sparks 'n' Splash 's DMG. For 12s after triggering the above effect, Klee's ATK is increased by 60%. The spark is considered Elemental Burst DMG. The chance to summon a spark starts at 0%, increases by 8% every time a skill fails to summon a spark, and resets to 0% when a spark is summoned. The spark summoning attempt will be triggered once per use of Klee's Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst. c2.name: Explosive Frags
c2.effect: Description Hexerei Buff Being hit by Jumpy Dumpty 's mines decreases opponents' DEF by 23% for 10s. When Klee's Elemental Skill hits an opponent, that opponent's DEF will be decreased by 23% for 10s.

c3.name: Exquisite Compound
c3.effect: Increases the Level of Jumpy Dumpty by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Sparkly Explosion
c4.effect: Description Hexerei Buff Preview If Klee leaves the field during the duration of Sparks 'n' Splash , her departure triggers an explosion that deals 555% of her ATK as AoE Pyro DMG . An explosion will be triggered if Klee leaves the field while Sparks 'n' Splash is active or when Sparks 'n' Splash ends, dealing 555% of ATK as AoE Pyro DMG . If Klee is on-field when the explosion occurs, its DMG will be increased by 100%. Hover over previews to view in higher quality. ( Preview Preferences ) Media:Constellation Sparkly Explosion.mp4

c5.name: Nova Burst
c5.effect: Increases the Level of Sparks 'n' Splash by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Blazing Delight
c6.effect: Description Hexerei Buff While under the effects of Sparks 'n' Splash , Klee will regenerate 3 Energy for all members of the party (excluding Klee) every 3s. When Sparks 'n' Splash is used, all party members will gain a 10% Pyro DMG Bonus for 25s. While under the effects of Sparks 'n' Splash , Klee will regenerate 3 Energy for all members of the party (excluding Klee) every 3s. When Sparks 'n' Splash is used, all party members will gain a 10% Pyro DMG Bonus for 25s. Hexerei: Secret Rite When Klee uses an Explosive Spark, there is a 50% chance it will not be consumed.
